title: Link constructs
body: One task per link construct. Every URL is on example.invalid or example.com.

title: Org link with padded url and label
Trailing punctuation is handed back to the sentence
body: Stop https://example.invalid/notes/stop. Comma https://example.invalid/notes/comma, ellipsis https://example.invalid/notes/dots… semicolon https://example.invalid/notes/semi; bang https://example.invalid/notes/bang!? guillemet https://example.invalid/notes/quote»

title: Unbalanced closing paren is trimmed, balanced parens are kept
Org verbatim and code markers are peeled off
Duplicate url, labelled occurrence first
body: [[https://example.invalid/dupe/a][Canonical label]] and again bare https://example.invalid/dupe/a here.

title: Self-hosted jira host classifies as jira
Row order resolves a host matching two systems
Unknown host falls back to the host, minus www.
body: Plain https://sub.example.invalid/b and http://www.example.com/a over http.

title: An unparseable url classifies as link
Scheme-only fragments are not links
body: Nothing here: https://, or https:// alone, or https://.

title: Org internal links are not reported but are masked
A non-web org link scheme is not reported
body: [[ftp://example.invalid/pub/file][Archive drop]] is org navigation, not a web link.

title: Title link https://example.invalid/title/link comes first
body:
Body line one.
Second line https://example.invalid/body/line-two here.
Third line https://example.invalid/body/line-three here.
